title: Fire damages Pittsfield home just weeks before owner planned to move in - NewsBreak
text: PITTSFIELD, Mass. (WWLP) – Pittsfield fire crews were called to a structure fire Wednesday afternoon on Valentine Road. According to Deputy Fire Chief Neil Myers, the department received multiple calls just before 5 p.m. reporting a fire at the single-story ranch home at 58 Valentine Road. Four engine companies, a ladder company, and the Deputy Chief were sent to the scene. Engine 1 was the first to arrive and observed flames coming from the right side exterior of the home. Firefighters immediately stretched a hoseline to begin fire attack. The sheriff reported that he was unsure whether anyone was still inside the building. The home was confirmed to be unoccupied, and the homeowner arrived about 10 minutes after crews began working. Firefighters had the fire under control within 10 minutes of arrival. The fire caused damage primarily to a bathroom and the adjacent exterior area, though the rest of the home suffered heavy smoke damage. No injuries were reported. The homeowner had recently purchased the property and was in the process of renovating it ahead of moving in later this month. The fire was supported by Dalton and Lenox fire departments, along with eight off-duty Pittsfield firefighters. The Pittsfield Fire Department’s Fire Investigation Unit is working to determine the cause and origin of the fire.
